description:
[Game reference] One animal, NPC or boss: HP, attacks, senses, speeds, gather yields, weapons, loot. `hp`, `damage_taken` (% per damage type), `attacks` (`damage`, `type`), `attack_interval_s`, `attack_range`,
`senses` (vision/sense range and angle, hearing), `aggro_range`, `speeds` (m/s per gait), `chase_speed`,
`flee_below_health`, `gather` (full-harvest yields), `weapons` (NPCs: per-shot damage after the NPC's damage scale),
`wear`, `loot_url` (opens the loot simulator on its body/crate). Bosses add guns, rockets, crates, respawn and
explosives to destroy. Use for animal/NPC health, damage, aggro range, speed, harvest yield; loot_url opens the loot simulator. Link https://rust.wiki/bestiary/<key>.
name: get_creature
